About the job

Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change. By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses. From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.Job DescriptionThe Lead QA Automation will play a crucial role in shaping and executing the automated testing strategy for the organization and ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products through the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated testing solutions. This position demands a seasoned professional with a deep understanding of test automation frameworks, software development life cycle (SDLC), and a proven track record of successfully leading automation initiatives and and the ability to mentor and guide team members. You will be a key player in ensuring the reliability and efficiency of software releases while fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities:       Develop and implement an automation strategy aligned with overall testing and development goals. Design and develop a scalable and maintainable automation framework using Selenium and Python. Oversee the implementation and integration of automation tools into the testing process. Lead the development of automated test scripts using Python for functional, regression, and performance testing. Review and provide guidance on coding practices to the automation team. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing. Collaborate with the QA team to develop test plans and strategies, including automation test coverage. Ensure test cases cover functional, integration, and regression testing scenarios. Investigate and report defects and collaborate with the development team to resolve issues. personal_details.label: Senior SDET | API & UI Automation | Java · Python · Microservices
personal_details.summary: Senior SDET with 6 years scaling API and UI automation across airline, quick-commerce, and OTT microservice domains. Architected 1000+ test case suites using REST Assured, TestNG, and Cucumber BDD; reduced QA overhead by 12 hrs/week through AI-assisted automation (AiDE). Experienced in shift-left testing, CI/CD integration, and observability-driven quality across distributed systems.

achievements: PNR Linking & SSR [REST Assured · ReadyAPI · BDD · AiDE] : Architected automation frameworks for airline domain; built 1000+ test cases cutting effort from 750 to 50 man-hours (93% reduction).
Order Bags [REST Assured · AiDE · E2E] : Leveraged Agentic AI (AiDE) to accelerate framework implementation by 50% and reduce test drafting time by 75% across service-level and E2E validations.
Automated Kibana log analysis, issue reporting, and data quality validation pipelines; eliminated manual intervention and saved 12 hrs/week of QA overhead.
Drove shift-left testing practices using Azure DevOps and BDD Cucumber, reducing bug leakage to production across 3 airline microservice domains.
Automated end-to-end API flows and DB validations using the Ekam Java Framework for 4 key features, achieving 60% test coverage in a microservices-based Merchant Service suite.
Led observability-driven root cause analysis of daily stability failures using Allure reports, Google Metrics Explorer, and Kibana across GCP-hosted services.
Owned full SDLC feature testing : planning through deployment ensuring minimal production bug leakage via Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
Designed a BDD automation framework using Python, Appium, and TestRail API; automated ~50% of sanity suite, saving ~5 man-days/month.
Contributed to a ₹100Cr OTT app under Agile SDLC; directly improved iOS App Store rating from 1.9 → 3.5 through systematic API and stability testing.
Performed domain API, stability, and KPI testing for Web and iOS platforms using Charles Proxy, Postman, and Burp Suite.
